description: Programmes d'actions de prévention des inondations (PAPI) en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. This data represents the scope of flood prevention action programmes (PAPIs). PAPIs are tools for implementing the natural flood risk prevention policy that complement existing regulatory arrangements (such as natural flood risk prevention plans). Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Flood prevention action programmes (PAPI) in Pays de la Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région des Pays de la Loire. Its keywords include eau, environnement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2020-08-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
